ownership.quote: Labring Inc. is headquartered in the United States. Data collected may be transferred to and processed in the U.S. or other countries...

stage.note: No press release, Crunchbase/Tracxn profile, or company statement about any funding round was found. GitHub org 'labring' self-describes only as 'wallfacer lab' with no investor or funding mentions. Bing/DuckDuckGo searches (English and Chinese, multiple phrasings) for 'Sealos funding', 'Labring funding', 'Sealos investors', 'Sealos 融资' returned zero relevant results. Crunchbase and the Sealos blog are both behind Cloudflare bot-challenge pages that could not be bypassed in the time budget. Given the open-core (Kubernetes PaaS) product, self-serve Stripe billing, and no visible outside-investor signaling anywhere on sealos.io, it is plausibly bootstrapped/self-funded, but this is not confirmed.

note: Sealos DevBox is a product of Labring Inc. (GitHub org 'labring', self-described as 'wallfacer lab'), the company behind the open-core Sealos Kubernetes-based cloud OS (source-available under the Sealos Sustainable Use License, not OSI open source). No funding round, accelerator affiliation, investor, or revenue figure could be found via GitHub, Hacker News, Bing/DuckDuckGo (English + Chinese), or Crunchbase (blocked by Cloudflare/bot-challenge) within the research time budget. Founder/maintainer activity centers on GitHub user 'fanux' (@labring). Buyers should treat funding status as unconfirmed/unknown rather than assume bootstrapped.
